subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: Where a repository holds recognized stack marker files (the ecosystem defaults' marker set — one detection source) and no verification manifest, the codegate seed verb shall write a closed-schema-valid template manifest declaring the detected stack — verb commands filled from the ecosystem defaults where real defaults exist, and as named to-be-edited placeholders otherwise — for the operator to own and edit; the harness's runtime reading is unchanged (FR-5).
rationale: the authoring aid that closes the fresh-operand gap while the manifest stays declared, human-owned data
fit_criterion: on manifest-less fixtures per supported stack, seed writes a manifest that closed-parses (FR-5's parser), declares the marker-matched stack, carries real defaults where the ecosystem ships them and named placeholders otherwise; the harness consumes the seeded manifest identically to a hand-authored one
